title: org.projectfile.pages extension (v1)
description: Standalone contract for the value at the org.projectfile.pages subtree: the page collections a project documents, one page per item, each rendered by the project’s own executable. Rules are one kind of collection; presets, collectors, plugins, formats and commands are others, and a consumer knows collections, never a kind. Each key names a collection. By convention `<command> --format json` prints the collection’s catalog, committed as docs/<name>.json (docs/<lang>/<name>.json per declared language), and `<command> --format markdown --output DIR --lang L` renders one page per catalog item into DIR.

name.description: The collection name: lowercase words joined by single hyphens. It is the default subcommand and the catalog’s file name (docs/<name>.json), so it carries no character a shell or a file system would treat specially.

title.description: The heading the collection’s part carries in every rendered language (`{en: Rules, es: Reglas}`).

command.description: The argv that prints the catalog and renders the pages, before `--format`. Absent => the command exported by the project’s artifact (org.projectfile.artifacts{command}) followed by the collection name. An argv list, never a shell string, so no consumer has to split or quote it.

localizedString.description: BCP 47 language-tagged string map, or a bare string treated as { und: <string> } (v1 §7).
